s1.syndrome_frame: Acute spinal cord injury with quadriplegia and autonomic dysfunction
key_facts: MRI of cervical spine showed spinal cord compression with anterolisthesis at C4 and C5
Diffusion-weighted imaging revealed reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute spinal cord injury with quadriplegia and autonomic dysfunction
key_facts: MRI of cervical spine showed spinal cord compression with anterolisthesis at C4 and C5
Diffusion-weighted imaging revealed reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter

differentials: Spinal cord injury due to osteoporotic fracture
Spinal cord infarction due to aortic dissection
Spinal cord compression due to cervical spine osteochondroma
Spinal cord injury without radiographic abnormality
Spinal cord infarction due to fibrocartilaginous embolism

shortlist.label: Traumatic spinal cord injury
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with quadriplegia and spinal cord compression after a fall

shortlist.label: Spinal cord compression
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed spinal cord compression with anterolisthesis at C4 and C5

shortlist.label: Cervical spine fracture
shortlist.why_kept: MRI and physical examination suggest a cervical spine injury

shortlist.label: Spinal cord contusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with a spinal cord contusion

shortlist.label: Cervical spine ligamentous injury
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed ligament disruptions at C4 and C5, suggesting a ligamentous injury

raw.rationale: The patient's history of falling out of bed, followed by immediate quadriplegia, urinary and stool incontinence, and hypothermia, combined with MRI findings of spinal cord compression and reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Spinal cord compression
rejected.why: While present, it is a component of the larger injury pattern

rejected.label: Cervical spine fracture
rejected.why: Not explicitly mentioned in the MRI findings

rejected.label: Spinal cord contusion
rejected.why: Contusion is a type of injury, but the overall clinical picture suggests a more severe traumatic injury

rejected.label: Cervical spine ligamentous injury
rejected.why: Ligamentous injury is noted, but the primary issue is the spinal cord injury itself

gold: Complete spinal cord injury (SCI) at C4-C5 level with intramedullary hemorrhage
